Tata Board's Decision Sparks Debate on Shareholder Rights

A dispute between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts has escalated into a wider discussion about the balance of power between professional management and controlling shareholders. Experts suggest the board's defiance of the owner's wishes has created a situation where litigation may be the only recourse. The situation highlights a conflict over corporate governance and the authority of a patriarch versus the board's decisions.
